lucee.notes: Lucee returns the index of the match, while ACF returns a Boolean, both of which are truthy

name: ArrayContains
description: Returns the position of the first element in the array that matches the item that we are searching for, or 0 if the item is not found.
syntax: ArrayContains( array haystack, object needle, [boolean substringMatch] )

params.name: haystack
params.description: The array in which to search for the item

params.name: needle
params.description: The item that we are looking for in the array

params.name: substringMatch
params.description: If set to true then a substring match will also return an array position. This will only work with simple values. Passing true with complex objects will throw an exception.
